label: Our Foundation
heading: Beth Muturi's Vision for Mukuru
para1: In 2017, Beth Muturi walked the narrow paths of Mukuru kwa Reuben and saw what statistics miss — children without mentors, women without safety nets, youth without futures mapped out for them. She didn't write a report. She started a movement.
quote: If we don't stand up for these children, who will? The answer was always: we will.
para2: Today, The Rising Mukuru runs mentorship circles, mental health outreach, and safe spaces for girls across the settlement. Every programme is built from lived experience — by people who know this community, because they are this community.
